headline: Russia Sells 6.2 Tonnes of Gold in September as Reserves Fall
summary: Russia sold 200,000 troy ounces of gold in September, lowering its sovereign bullion reserves to their lowest level since the end of 2019.
why: Central bank bullion reserves are a key indicator of a nation's sovereign financial stability and foreign exchange management strategy.

impacts.name: Russia
impacts.why: Selling gold reserves alters sovereign financial stability metrics and foreign exchange management strategies.
